connection.text: Connection Name*Give your connection a unique name to help you identify it in the future.Endpoint URL*Plane API base URL. Use the cloud default or your self-hosted Plane endpoint.API Key*Workspace-scoped Plane API key used for authentication.Workspace Slug*The workspace slug from your Plane URL, for example `acme-team` in `/workspaces/acme-team/`.ProxyAdd a proxy if you cannot access Plane directly.Custom Rate LimitMaximum number of API requests per hour. Leave blank for default.
